diagnosis.reasoning: Queue depth and queue-time exploded while running batch size, iteration tokens, KV usage and generation rate all collapsed, and per-iteration GPU costs (prefill_time, prefill_kv_computed, inter-token latency) are exactly unchanged — so the GPU is idle-ish, not overloaded, and KV/preemption/prefix-cache are all clean. Requests are piling up before they reach the engine, which points to a host-side bottleneck (CPU/API-server/scheduler stall) that feeds queueing and ttft directly; arrival rate fell only as a downstream consequence of backpressure, so this is not a capacity story.
